findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_dealer_levels, get_crypto_coin, ask_novo, get_crypto_map, get_daily_strike, get_retail_chatter, search_journal, get_session_history, get_robinhood_trending, get_equity_map, get_base_rates, get_crypto_screen, get_ticker_brief · Private data: get_volatility_record, ask_novo, get_crypto_map, get_congress_trades, get_daily_strike, get_session_history, get_stocks_onchain, get_robinhood_trending, get_prediction_markets, get_perps, get_perp_history, get_stock_tokens, get_equity_map, get_base_rates, get_crypto_screen · Public sink: get_crypto_map, get_alerts, create_alert, get_equity_map, get_base_rates, get_crypto_screen · Destructive: get_congress_trades, get_daily_strike, get_gamma_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_dealer_levels, get_crypto_coin, ask_novo, get_crypto_map, get_daily_strike, get_retail_chatter, search_journal, get_session_history, get_robinhood_trending, get_equity_map, get_base_rates, get_crypto_screen, get_ticker_brief · Private data: get_volatility_record, ask_novo, get_crypto_map, get_congress_trades, get_daily_strike, get_session_history, get_stocks_onchain, get_robinhood_trending, get_prediction_markets, get_perps, get_perp_history, get_stock_tokens, get_equity_map, get_base_rates, get_crypto_screen · Public sink: get_crypto_map, get_alerts, create_alert, get_equity_map, get_base_rates, get_crypto_screen · Destructive: get_congress_trades, get_daily_strike, get_gamma_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
